tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. Ambient glows sit on this layer only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the nav rail. The default home for content.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elements inside a panel that need to lift: rows on hover, input fields, the session card header.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks behind progress bars and rings, code blocks, empty states inside a panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around panels and between list rows. Decorative only: never the sole separator of controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, timestamps, labels, axis text. On ground, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text such as placeholder copy and 'Pending' states. Meets 4.5:1 on surface; keep it off surface-raised in dark for long text.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary buttons, active nav item, links, focus ring, running progress. Text in signal reads on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of signal fills and links.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active nav item's fill, the info pill's ground. Text on it: ink or signal.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: beacon
tokens.usage: Needs-your-attention: permission requests from an agent, proposed memory notes, drift in generated config. Never decoration.

tokens.name: beacon-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of beacon pills and the attention banner. Text on it: beacon or ink.

tokens.name: on-beacon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a beacon fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success: pipeline passed, review approved, session finished, memory confirmed. Teal, so it is told apart from danger by more than hue.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of ok pills.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution: pipeline pending, rate limit near, RAM budget approaching. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of warn pills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure: pipeline failed, changes requested, session crashed, connector offline. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of danger pills.

tokens.name: glow-signal
tokens.usage: Ambient radial glow behind the hero panel and live charts. Only on ground or inside a panel's own background, never on text.

tokens.name: glow-beacon
tokens.usage: Ambient warm glow at the page edge when something needs attention. At most one per screen.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The greeting on Home and empty-state headlines. Once per screen.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers in Metric tiles and inside rings. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: View titles at the top of a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Claude Code wants to run npm test in apps/web.
styles.usage: Default running text, descriptions, memory note content.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines under a row title, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels, pill text, column headers. Always uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Model ids, branch names, MR/issue keys, file paths, token counts, agent output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical), gap between rows in a dense list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on narrow screens; row padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in the dashboard grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space above a view title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Separation between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, keys, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inner cards such as session cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels on the dashboard grid.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, toggles, progress bar ends.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every dashboard panel. Panels float on ground; nothing inside a panel gets its own shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the permission dialog.
